mechanism: Both drugs have gastrointestinal irritation potential and may have additive effects on GI adverse effects; risedronate absorption is pH-sensitive and raloxifene may affect oral bioavailability through GI effects.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; monitor for GI symptoms including dyspepsia, nausea, and esophageal irritation; ensure adequate hydration and upright positioning after dosing.
